captureMode: same-origin unsandboxed iframe harness - actual Three.js scene rendered to offscreen WebGLRenderTarget

caseOuterDiameter.rationale: Bounds the candidate case body without changing the movement.
caseOuterDiameter.risk: Local crown recess and case-tube geometry remain unresolved.
caseOuterDiameter.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

movementCavityDiameter.rationale: Keeps the protected movement envelope inside the candidate body.
movementCavityDiameter.risk: Not a manufacturing tolerance or casing-ring specification.
movementCavityDiameter.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

radialMovementClearance.rationale: Provides an explicit non-zero visual and assembly budget.
radialMovementClearance.risk: Must be replaced by verified casing and mounting requirements.
radialMovementClearance.implementationDependency: Verify casing ring, clamps, fasteners, and shock clearance.

bezelOuterDiameter.rationale: Maintains a readable boundary around the display aperture.
bezelOuterDiameter.risk: Bezel profile and retention system are not yet modeled.
bezelOuterDiameter.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

dialApertureDiameter.formula: max(S86 dial ring, index circle, 2 × hand reach) + aperture margin
dialApertureDiameter.rationale: Keeps the S86 dial ring, index circle, and hand-tip envelopes visible.
dialApertureDiameter.risk: Physical dial blank and rehaut dimensions remain unverified.
dialApertureDiameter.implementationDependency: Reconfirm after physical dial, bezel, and crystal integration.

crystalClearDiameter.rationale: Keeps the clear crystal area outside the candidate display aperture.
crystalClearDiameter.risk: Crystal seat and optical distortion are not represented.
crystalClearDiameter.implementationDependency: Define crystal profile, seat, gasket, and bezel retention.

crystalInnerY.rationale: Places the crystal inner surface in front of the minute-hand extreme.
crystalInnerY.risk: Dynamic hand deflection and manufacturing tolerances are not evaluated.
crystalInnerY.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

crystalOuterY.rationale: Completes the candidate front thickness budget.
crystalOuterY.risk: Crystal thickness is an exterior design assumption, not an ETA value.
crystalOuterY.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

frontHandClearance.rationale: Creates a positive explanatory gap ahead of the minute hand.
frontHandClearance.implementationDependency: Verify hand stack, flex, shock, and crystal geometry.

casebackInnerY.rationale: Places the caseback inner surface behind the bridge extreme.
casebackInnerY.risk: Rotor-free educational model still needs local screw and bridge checks.
casebackInnerY.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

casebackOuterY.rationale: Completes the candidate rear thickness budget.
casebackOuterY.risk: Caseback profile and transparent-window construction remain unresolved.
casebackOuterY.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

rearBridgeClearance.rationale: Creates a positive visual gap behind the bridge envelope.
rearBridgeClearance.risk: Not a production shock or service clearance.
rearBridgeClearance.implementationDependency: Verify screws, caseback window, gasket, and service access.

totalCaseThickness.rationale: Is fully explained by the protected Y envelope, clearances, crystal, and caseback.
totalCaseThickness.risk: ETA 4.50 mm is not used because its datum mapping is unresolved.
totalCaseThickness.implementationDependency: Requires physical exterior Geometry, material, tolerance, and assembly review in the implementation phase.

crownTubeAxisY.rationale: Keeps the case tube coaxial with the protected crown/stem system.
crownTubeAxisY.risk: Changing this value would break the established keyless interface.
crownTubeAxisY.implementationDependency: Case tube must adapt to this fixed axis; the mechanism must not move.

crownOuterProjection.rationale: Retains the original conservative bounding-radius projection for comparison; formal local crown projections use the circular case intersection at stem Z.
crownOuterProjection.risk: This bounding-radius value is not the local case-wall projection and must not be used for crown finger-access approval.
crownOuterProjection.implementationDependency: Implement and test the crown recess/tube around fixed A.7 positions.

caseOuterIntersectionXAtStemZ.rationale: Locates the circular candidate case outer surface on the protected crown/stem axis.
caseOuterIntersectionXAtStemZ.risk: Valid only while the stem-axis Z lies strictly inside the candidate case radius.
caseOuterIntersectionXAtStemZ.implementationDependency: Final exterior implementation must preserve the circular-interface assumption or re-audit the local intersection.

movementCavityIntersectionXAtStemZ.rationale: Locates the circular candidate movement-cavity surface on the protected crown/stem axis.
movementCavityIntersectionXAtStemZ.risk: Valid only while the stem-axis Z lies strictly inside the candidate cavity radius.
movementCavityIntersectionXAtStemZ.implementationDependency: Recompute if the final cavity ceases to be circular at the crown interface.

localCaseWallAxialLength.rationale: Measures the candidate case-wall path along the actual crown/stem axis rather than at the maximum case radius.
localCaseWallAxialLength.risk: Does not include a crown recess, seat, gasket, thread, or manufacturing allowance.
localCaseWallAxialLength.implementationDependency: Use as an axial tube-length candidate only; verify final case and tube construction.

crownCenterProjectionWindLocal.rationale: Reports the position-1 crown-center projection from the local circular case surface.
crownCenterProjectionWindLocal.risk: Finger access and recess operability remain unverified.
crownCenterProjectionWindLocal.implementationDependency: Human and physical interaction review with the implemented exterior.

crownCenterProjectionSetLocal.rationale: Reports the position-2 crown-center projection from the local circular case surface.
crownCenterProjectionSetLocal.implementationDependency: Human and physical interaction review with the implemented exterior.

crownOuterProjectionWindLocal.rationale: Reports the position-1 crown end projection from the local circular case surface.
crownOuterProjectionWindLocal.risk: Does not establish a finger-access requirement.
crownOuterProjectionWindLocal.implementationDependency: Validate crown recess and access after exterior Geometry exists.

crownOuterProjectionSetLocal.rationale: Reports the position-2 crown end projection from the local circular case surface.
crownOuterProjectionSetLocal.implementationDependency: Validate crown recess and access after exterior Geometry exists.

crownTubeOuterDiameter.rationale: Provides a formal exterior tube diameter for local geometric comparison.
crownTubeOuterDiameter.risk: Seat, gasket, thread, press-fit, water resistance, and manufacturing tolerance are unverified.
crownTubeOuterDiameter.implementationDependency: Finalize crown-tube construction only in the exterior implementation phase.

crownTubeInnerDiameter.rationale: Creates a traceable positive educational clearance around the protected stem.
crownTubeInnerDiameter.risk: Not a manufacturing bore, running fit, gasket seat, or water-resistance specification.
crownTubeInnerDiameter.implementationDependency: Verify stem fit, sealing, wear, and tolerances during exterior implementation.

crownTubeAnnularWall.rationale: Makes the candidate tube wall explicit for geometric feasibility checks.
crownTubeAnnularWall.risk: Not a strength, threading, sealing, or manufacturability approval.
crownTubeAnnularWall.implementationDependency: Select material and construction before validating a production wall.

crownTubeAxialLengthCandidate.rationale: Uses the local circular case-wall path as a traceable first tube-length candidate.
crownTubeAxialLengthCandidate.risk: Seat depth, gasket, thread, press-fit, and exterior protrusion are not included.
crownTubeAxialLengthCandidate.implementationDependency: Finalize only after case and tube attachment Geometry is designed.

lugToLug.rationale: Expresses the candidate total case length from the case body.
lugToLug.risk: Wrist fit and spring-bar construction are not verified.
lugToLug.implementationDependency: Human proportion review and final lug Geometry.

lugWidth.rationale: Defines a comparable attachment interface across the candidates.
lugWidth.risk: Not derived from a commercial watch or manufacturing standard.

strapWidth.rationale: Keeps the strap interface aligned with the candidate lug opening.
strapWidth.risk: Strap taper, thickness, and material are deferred.
strapWidth.implementationDependency: Final strap design after lug Geometry approval.

caseWall.rationale: Defines the radial case-body budget used to derive the candidate outer diameter.
caseWall.risk: Not a structural, machining, sealing, or impact-resistance specification.
caseWall.implementationDependency: Finalize material, section profile, fasteners, and local crown opening.

bezelInset.rationale: Keeps a consistent comparison offset between the candidate body and bezel.
bezelInset.risk: Bezel seat, crystal retention, and gasket geometry are unverified.
bezelInset.implementationDependency: Final bezel and crystal retention design.

dialApertureMargin.rationale: Makes each candidate display margin explicit around the protected S86 envelope.
dialApertureMargin.risk: Physical dial blank and rehaut geometry are unverified.
dialApertureMargin.implementationDependency: Reconfirm with the physical dial, indices, bezel, and crystal.

crystalClearMargin.rationale: Provides a traceable clear-diameter margin for candidate comparison.
crystalClearMargin.risk: Optical distortion, seat width, and gasket compression are unverified.
crystalClearMargin.implementationDependency: Final crystal profile, seat, and gasket design.

crystalThickness.rationale: Completes the explicit front thickness budget without changing the hand stack.
crystalThickness.risk: Not a strength or material specification.
crystalThickness.implementationDependency: Final crystal material and structural review.

casebackThickness.rationale: Completes the explicit rear thickness budget around the bridge envelope.
casebackThickness.risk: Window, gasket, thread, and fastening construction are unverified.

lugExtension.rationale: Defines the candidate lug reach used only for 2D proportion comparison.
lugExtension.risk: Wrist fit, spring-bar position, and lug strength are unverified.
lugExtension.implementationDependency: Human proportion review and final lug Geometry.
